title: results/<run>/<m>/<domain>/review.json (domain: playwright-ui, playwright-api or k6): a reviewer's verdict on every test of the module in one review round, per rubric dimension. `review.mjs check` checks that every test was reviewed in this round, that every finding cites a real file:line, and derives the overall verdict (pass exactly when no blocker or major remains) into review-findings.md. Nobody types a verdict.

severity.description: blocker or major: the fixer must act; minor or info: noted, never blocks.

location.description: file:line the finding is about, relative to the product's Playwright or k6 repo (a real file, a line within it).

round.description: The review round in the reviewer's prompt; a review from another round does not count.

tests.description: Keyed by the test id: a UI test case id (TC-...), an API scenario id (API-...) or a k6 script id (K6-...).

intent.description: The test proves what its case or scenario says (preconditions, action, oracle), not something adjacent.

assertion.description: It asserts the behavior, message or state change, not just status or visibility; no tautologies.

flakiness.description: No dependency on order, time or data; no shared state between tests; no race-prone waits.

data-safety.description: Synthetic, unique data; cleanup only of entities the run created; no reliance on pre-existing data.

general.description: Findings not about one test (a shared helper, the lib).
